description: This file contains unit tests for the WebUtil class in the org.openmrs.web package, using the JUnit 5 testing framework. It tests various utility methods related to locale normalization, context path retrieval, and locale sanitization.

classes.name: WebUtilTest
classes.description: Test class for WebUtil utility methods, focusing on locale normalization, context path, and sanitization functions.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnEmptyStringWhenWebAppNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that getContextPath returns an empty string when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is null.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnEmptyStringWhenWebAppNameIsEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that getContextPath returns an empty string when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is an empty string.

methods.name: getContextPath_shouldReturnValueSpecifiedInWebAppName
methods.description: Tests that getContextPath correctly returns a path segment when WebConstants.WEBAPP_NAME is set.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldIgnoreLeadingSpaces
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale correctly ignores leading spaces in locale strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldAcceptLanguageOnlyLocales
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale correctly processes language-only locale strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotAcceptInvalidLocales
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale returns null for invalid locale strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithEmptyStrings
methods.description: Ensures normalizeLocale returns null when given an empty string.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithWhitespaceOnly
methods.description: Ensures normalizeLocale returns null when given a whitespace-only string.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithTab
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale safely handles strings with non-printable characters, like tabs.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithUnicode
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale safely handles Unicode characters.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithSingleChar
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale safely handles single character strings.

methods.name: normalizeLocale_shouldNotFailWithUnderline
methods.description: Tests that normalizeLocale safely handles strings with underscore characters.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales_shouldSkipOverInvalidLocales
methods.description: Tests that sanitizeLocales filters out invalid locale entries from the input string.

methods.name: sanitizeLocales_shouldNotFailWithEmptyString
methods.description: Ensures sanitizeLocales handles empty input strings gracefully.
